requiredScope: The complete required language and role scope remains in force.

Mutation/UpdateAssignment.role: A scalar write of a native int4 or text field of one ordinary target.
Mutation/UpdateAssignment.structure: A resolved write coordinate and a same-kind reference or typed constant, or explicit NULL. Each reference addresses occurrence zero.
Mutation/UpdateAssignment.conditions: An int4 target admits its signed literal or field role. A text target admits a native text literal or field role. Both admit NULL. The owning UPDATE checks the exact read and write kinds at their target positions, the distinctness of write positions and the presence filter. Matching external declarations make the corresponding target positions writable.
Mutation/UpdateAssignment.meaning: Each operand sees the same old row even when a referenced field is also written by the command. The new row is observed by RETURNING.
Mutation/UpdateAssignment.sql: Emit named SET targets and exact scoped old-field reads in the declared order. Render text literals with fixed native UTF-8 text semantics.

externalInterpretation: Use the same ordinary table with nullable native text fields and explicitly writable native int4 and text positions. Preserve exact UTF-8 bytes and inspect the physical row state before and after each command.
observations: A text literal, including empty, quoted, multiline and Unicode strings, round-trips as the same native value.
A simultaneous swap of two fields reads both old values.
An explicit NULL is distinct from empty text and is visible through RETURNING.
Preserve mixed returned types, exact result labels, duplicate rows and affected count.

finite.completeness: Reconstruct the assignment form, first write position and checked filter from the actual published update.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary the text operands and order, read/write overlaps, nullable rows, mixed signed/text assignments and returned slots. Include quote, backslash, whitespace, empty and multibyte cases.

analysis: Assign a decoded bare string to a statically known text slot.
Copy a qualified old text field to another text field.
Swap two native text fields in one update and return their new values.
Write explicit NULL and a signed integer in one command.
Assign an explicitly typed multiline or multibyte text literal.
negative: Pass a signed operand as a text assignment value.
Pass a text operand as an int4 assignment value.
Use a resolved write role that disagrees with the kind of the physical slot.
Use a resolved old text read that disagrees with the kind of the physical slot.
Use a read coordinate from another occurrence.
faults: Discard one operand in a simultaneous swap.
Render the other text field instead of the original source field.
Change an empty text literal to SQL NULL.

evidence.P01: Record the exact target type, occurrence, ordinal and old-row operand of each assignment.
evidence.P02: Check same-kind assignments and closure of every target position by construction.
evidence.P03: Hold only immutable field references, scalar values, row-selection predicates and ordered assignments.
evidence.P04: Compose each assignment over the old row and the ordered result layout over the new row.
evidence.P05: Preserve detached ordered lists and final readonly fields.
evidence.P06: Compare native result metadata and physical effects after applying the exact composed SQL.
evidence.Q01: Reject mismatched native kinds and invalid write or read ownership.
evidence.Q02: Check all direct finite identities and supported parsed inputs.
evidence.Q03: Independently evaluate effects and preserve the old/new row distinction.
evidence.Q04: Run both exact releases and detect the known read-role, swap and NULL differences.
evidence.Q05: Bind all observations and fault patches to the measured distribution.

open: Computed text write expressions, text INSERT writes, custom coercions and other target types retain their own obligations.
trust: Checked PostgreSQL statement and text roles
